Slop Expenses · free, in your browser

A free Expensify alternative, in your browser

If you want to record business expenses without an online account, Slop Expenses runs in your browser and keeps every expense, receipt photo and mileage claim on this device.

Try Slop Expenses

How to do it

  1. Record an expense with New expense, or read one from a receipt photo with From a receipt…
  2. Log trips with Mileage…
  3. Record bills you have not paid yet and mark them paid later.
  4. See monthly totals in Summary and Download CSV for your accountant.

What it has: expenses by supplier and category, the tax to reclaim, receipt reading on the device, mileage claims, bills to pay, posting to the ledger and CSV export. What it does not have: approvals, a team, card feeds or reimbursement payments.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Expenses runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Is Slop Expenses made by Expensify?

No. Slopographic is not affiliated with Expensify. Expensify is a trademark of its owner, and the name is used here only to describe what people search for.

Can I use it on my phone?

Yes. It runs in the phone's browser, and From a receipt… can use the camera. The data stays in that browser.

Is there an account or a limit?

No account and no limit on expenses. Everything is kept in your browser.
